# Protocol types covered by Checkout Kit

Checkout Kit's semantic versioning covers these protocol types (UCP `2026-08-25`): the types its public API exposes, directly or through the fields of exposed models. Other protocol types follow the protocol package's own versioning.

## Models

Every model can be built with its builder or DSL (Kotlin) or its initializer (Swift).

| Type | Platforms | Members |
|---|---|---|
| `AppliedDiscount` | Kotlin, Swift | `allocations`, `amount`, `automatic`, `code`, `eligibility`, `method`, `priority`, `provisional`, `title` |
| `Buyer` | Kotlin, Swift | `email`, `firstName`, `lastName`, `phoneNumber`, `additionalProperties` |
